hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 003 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until hyper-accuracy review and matching rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Explain AI product capabilities with a horizontal card rail where the active feature is emphasized.
purposeLayer: Feature carousel encourages scanning several capabilities while making one selected feature feel premium and current.
anatomyLayer: Section heading, view-more control, horizontal feature cards, icon badges, active center card with brighter border, card descriptions, and progress line.
hierarchyLayer: Heading first, active card second, neighboring cards third, progress line/control last.
gridRhythmLayer: Wide horizontal rail with partial cards and one emphasized center card on dark background.
densityLimitLayer: Use 3-6 visible modules; active card may be larger or brighter, with one progress indicator.
originalityLayer: Learn active-feature carousel rhythm; transform card count, active state, icon system, and scroll indicator.
usageRuleLayer: Use for AI tools, SaaS modules, feature overviews, service capabilities, and platform categories.
layoutGesture: horizontal feature rail with active highlighted center card
sectionSilhouette: wide carousel strip with one enlarged glowing/outlined module
compositionTension: active state breaks equal-card monotony and creates browsing motion
focalPath: heading to active center feature to adjacent cards to progress cue
negativeSpaceShape: long dark track with card islands and low progress line
depthLayering: dark feature cards with active border and icon glow
moduleScaleVariation: one active card larger/brighter than surrounding cards
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact Aiso feature names, icon style, progress line, active-card dimensions, or dark-blue glow.
